description: Runs CookiePilot's cookie scan of a website on the confirmed account (public pages, no JavaScript) and returns the cookie declaration: cookies by consent category, unclassified ones and a panel link. Takes up to a minute.

hostname.description: Website hostname, e.g. example.com; defaults to the website added last (or given to create_account)

name: scan_cookies
title: Scan the website for cookies
